name: portfolio_storage_policies
query: drop policy if exists portfolio_media_authenticated_read on storage.objects; create policy portfolio_media_authenticated_read on storage.objects for select to authenticated using (bucket_id = 'portfolio-media'); drop policy if exists portfolio_media_authenticated_insert on storage.objects; create policy portfolio_media_authenticated_insert on storage.objects for insert to authenticated with check (bucket_id = 'portfolio-media'); drop policy if exists portfolio_media_authenticated_update on storage.objects; create policy portfolio_media_authenticated_update on storage.objects for update to authenticated using (bucket_id = 'portfolio-media') with check (bucket_id = 'portfolio-media');
